data.one_liner: Extended list widgets with garbage collection, viewport tracking and trailing layout support.
data.what_it_does: Provides ListView/GridView variants that can track which items enter the viewport, collect garbage indexes, and layout the last child specially (e.g., load‑more footers). It also offers a close‑to‑trailing option for reverse lists.
use_when: You need to know which items are visible for cache management
You want automatic load‑more/footer handling at the end of a list
You require a list that stays close to the trailing edge when reversed
avoid_when: You need a lightweight solution without extra delegate logic
weaknesses: Documentation is limited to README examples
